86a640ff83.q: How does Salesforce differentiate its industry cloud solutions from horizontal platform offerings?
86a640ff83.a: Industry Cloud at Salesforce is a specialized version of core software products like Sales or Service Cloud, designed to deliver outcomes and workflows specific to a given industry. It includes industry-specific data models, features, work functions, and deep industry business processes that transform the platform into an industry C360, helping customers serve their customers in a unique way.
86a640ff83.e: From Cloud to Verticalization to AgentForce – How Salesforce continues to Innovate

7bf8fdd087.q: What is the structure and size of Salesforce's AppExchange partner ecosystem for industry solutions?
7bf8fdd087.a: Salesforce has over 600 AppExchange partners for industries. These partners are recruited for specific industries and onboarded to understand Salesforce's full portfolio. They are highly committed to obtaining accreditations and certifications, implementing solutions, and creating value for mutual customers, serving as what Anderson-Williams calls an 'invisible army' that goes places Salesforce won't or can't go due to regulatory requirements.
7bf8fdd087.e: From Cloud to Verticalization to AgentForce – How Salesforce continues to Innovate

dcca086b57.q: When did Salesforce launch Financial Services Cloud and Health Cloud as its first industry-specific products?
dcca086b57.a: Salesforce announced its first true industry cloud product, Financial Services Cloud, in 2015, and shortly thereafter Health Cloud. Both were developed based on identified market opportunity and high customer demand. Financial Services Cloud became Salesforce's number one industry cloud, with Health Cloud ranking second.
dcca086b57.e: From Cloud to Verticalization to AgentForce – How Salesforce continues to Innovate

56a1a296d5.q: How many Salesforce industry clouds exist and when was the most recent one added?
56a1a296d5.a: Salesforce currently has 15 industry clouds. The most recent addition was approximately 45 to 60 days before this interview when Salesforce announced an acquisition of Pridix Spring, which added the 15th industry cloud to the Salesforce family.
56a1a296d5.e: From Cloud to Verticalization to AgentForce – How Salesforce continues to Innovate

d80fd54b88.q: What is the shared architecture that enables Salesforce to manage 15 different industry clouds simultaneously?
d80fd54b88.a: Salesforce uses a shared set of components and unified framework called common components and common services layer, which allows features developed for one industry to be easily repurposed for another. Applications like loyalty, lending, scheduling, and dispute resolution exist across all Salesforce industry clouds, enabling scalability while allowing industry teams to focus on industry-specific innovations.
d80fd54b88.e: From Cloud to Verticalization to AgentForce – How Salesforce continues to Innovate

37171806b4.q: How does Salesforce integrate Einstein One platform and Data Cloud into its industry cloud solutions?
37171806b4.a: Industry clouds are built on the Einstein One platform, which is fueled by Data Cloud and grounded in industry-specific data models. Data Cloud helps harmonize and enrich customer data, while Tableau provides AI-powered insights embedded across CRM products. This integration ensures customers receive relevant, contextual results specific to their industry within their workflow.
37171806b4.e: From Cloud to Verticalization to AgentForce – How Salesforce continues to Innovate
